title: Governed tag propagation is in Beta
body:
Tag propagation in Unity Catalog is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). When you enable tag propagation for a governed tag, Unity Catalog uses lineage to automatically apply that tag to derived tables and views whenever a supported operation runs, such as `CREATE TABLE AS SELECT`, `CREATE VIEW`, `INSERT INTO ... SELECT`, or `MERGE`. This keeps classification and ABAC enforcement consistent at both the table and column levels as data moves downstream.

See [Tag propagation](/aws/en/admin/governed-tags/tag-propagation).
